text_block_list.text: On the way home from an outing.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: *BEEP* *BEEP* *BEEP*!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Radar ping detected, radar ping detected! 
Team Golshi, deploy immediately!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Alright, time to roll out! Let's go, 
Trainer! Hiyah!

"—With those words, I was stuffed into a 
burlap sack and carried off to..."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Here, right here! She's gotta be here! It 
reeks of the unknown!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
What else could it be? Obviously, it's 
Nessie's lair!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Tsuchinoko, mermaids, and kappa— The 
Golshi Squad has tracked down all sorts of 
UMAs!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
On the name of the Super Elite 
Unidentified Creature Investigation Team, 
we're not going home tonight until we lay 
our eyes upon it!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
So yeah! Come up with a nice plan that'll 
make Nessie wanna show its face!

I'm not quite sure what's going on, but I 
guess I have no choice but to tag along.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Gaaah! Plain, plain, so plain! Plain as a 
wild ginger flower!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Nessie's not gonna show up unless you show 
some guts and keep watch doing an air 
chair!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
And so, the Heart-Pounding Wall-Sit 
Showdown begins!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I'll show you the greatest quadriceps in 
the world!
――10 minutes later.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Unununununu~~~~~!
—20 minutes later.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: No no no no nooooo!
—30 minutes later.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Huh, so you can eat these vines if you 
boil 'em.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
What are you on about? More importantly, 
let's cultivate a bunch of purslane at the 
academy and make some namul.

Afterward, I secretly planted the borrowed 
purslane into a flowerpot in the student 
council room, only to be thoroughly 
scolded for it.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, I get it now! I'll dance up a storm 
like a sparrow on fire!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Sore, sore, sore, sore♪ Seiya, seiya, 
seiya, seiya♪

—Gold Ship's snappy dance moves drew the 
eyes of the crowd...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Yaaah--!!

By the time the dance was over, a crowd 
had gathered.

text_block_list.name: Passing Dancer
text_block_list.text:
Nice step! Nice dancing! Nice groove! 
Bravo!

text_block_list.name: Passing Young Lady
text_block_list.text:
I feel like that gave me a real boost of 
energy~.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Thanks! The underdog Tracen Dance Club's 
revolution starts right here!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I'll carry on Yamaoka's will! Just you 
wait, nation! No, the entire world~~!

The passersby, knowing nothing of the 
circumstances, found themselves shedding 
quiet tears.
